coverage.formula: coverage = measured / (measured + offBookEst); offBookEst = suppressedChecks + excusedElements × 12 (GROUP_CHECKS sum = checks per fully-measured element; conservative — the 5 unskippable per-element checks are not counted). thresholds.offBookCap: 70% (FAIL(off-book) unless reviewed in coverage-review.json with written reason + owner task)

≥ 50% heuristic-paired — explicit data-spec binding is achievable (intro/usecase ≈0.8%)
